builds.d: An AoE build that increases skill range and DMG, causing phantoms to deal Explosion DMG to enemies upon disappearance.
A build that enhances the control and sustain of phantoms, ideal for fighting elite targets.

l.b: Reduces Main Skill Cooldown. ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ will explode upon vanishing.
l.s: Reduces the Cooldown of Pumpka Pummel (Main Skill) by 2s. ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ will explode upon vanishing, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Minion DMG.

l.b: The Main Skill deals additional DMG. When casting, removes all ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ from the battlefield and summons them again.
l.s: Pumpka Pummel (Main Skill) deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as AoE Umbra Skill DMG. When cast, removes all ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ from the battlefield and summons them again.

l.b: When a ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ vanishes, increases the Umbra DMG Taken of nearby targets.
l.s: When a ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ vanishes, increases the Umbra DMG Taken of nearby targets by ⟦0⟧ for 4s, up to 4 stacks.

l.b: When a ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ vanishes, Mistique gains a shield.
l.s: When a ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ vanishes, Mistique gains a shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of her Base Max HP, lasting for 10s, up to 4 stacks.

l.b: When a ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ vanishes, increases Mistique's ATK.
l.s: When a ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ vanishes, increases Mistique's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s, up to 4 stacks.

l.b: While in Exposure status, if the maximum number of ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ are on the battlefield, increases their duration and Minion DMG.
l.s: While in Exposure status, if the maximum number of ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ are on the battlefield, increases their duration. Also increases ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩' Minion DMG by ⟦0⟧ every 3s, up to 4 stacks.

l.b: When Mistique deals DMG, ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ will cast Whirlwind Slash.
l.s: When Mistique deals DMG, ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ will cast Whirlwind Slash, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Minion DMG. This effect can only be triggered once every 2.5s.

l.b: ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ has a chance to increase its DMG and stun the target.
l.s: When a ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ deals DMG, there is a 20% chance to increase its DMG by ⟦0⟧ and stun the target for 1s.

l.b: When Mistique deals DMG with an Auto Attack, restores HP to nearby ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩. Increases her Minion DMG.
l.s: When Mistique deals DMG with an Auto Attack, restores ⟦0⟧ HP to nearby ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩. This effect can only be triggered once per sec. Increases her Minion DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩' ATK SPD and Minion DMG.
l.s: Increases ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩' ATK SPD by ⟦0⟧ and Minion DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: The Ultimate can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩. When it triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases Mistique's ATK.
l.s:
Midnight ★ Terror (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩.
When it triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases Mistique's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 15s.

l.b: Increases the ATK of the ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ near Mistique.
l.s: Increases the ATK of the ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ near Mistique by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Mistique can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases the ATK of Mistique and the ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ on the battlefield.
l.s: Mistique can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases the ATK of Mistique and the ⟨Pumpka Phantom⟩ on the battlefield by ⟦0⟧ for 5s.

l.b: When Mistique casts the Ultimate, sacrifices all of her minions to increase Ultimate DMG.
l.s: When Mistique casts Midnight ★ Terror, sacrifices all of her minions, each increasing Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, up to 6 stacks.

l.b: Energy Charge Efficiency increases when Mistique casts the Main Skill or Support Skill.
l.s: Energy Charge Efficiency +⟦0⟧ for 10s when Mistique casts the Main Skill or Support Skill.

l.b: When Mistique deals damage with the Ultimate, increases her Ultimate DMG.
l.s: When Mistique deals DMG with Midnight ★ Terror (Ultimate), increases her Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 2s, up to 9 stacks.

builds.d: A build that extends skill duration and continuously boosts phantoms' DMG on the battlefield.
A build that allows skills to pull enemies and boosts the Explosion DMG of phantoms, ideal for the melee main Trekker.

l.b: Increases the duration of the magic circle. Also increases the Minion DMG of ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩.
l.s: Increases the duration of the magic circle by ⟦0⟧s. Also increases the Minion DMG of ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩ by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases the size and Minion DMG of the ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩ summoned by the same magic circle over time.
l.s: Increases the Minion DMG of the ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩ summoned by the same magic circle by ⟦0⟧ each time, up to 10 times. The summoned ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩ also grow larger over time.

l.b: Reduces the intervals between each summon of a ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩.
l.s: Reduces the intervals between each summon of a ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩' Minion DMG.
l.s: Increases ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩' Minion DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.s: There is a ⟦0⟧ chance the Support Skill can summon one more ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩.

l.b: Increases the radius of the Support Skill's magic circle that can pull in targets. When a ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩ in the circle explodes, increases its DMG.
l.s: The magic circle's radius is increased, and it can pull in weak enemies. When a ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩ in the circle explodes, increases its DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: The Support Skill's magic circle will follow targets. When a ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩ in the circle explodes, increases its DMG.
l.s: The magic circle will follow targets. When a ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩ in the circle explodes, increases its DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: The Support Skill's magic circle will deal DMG over time.
l.s: Summoning Circle (Support Skill)'s magic circle deals ⟦0⟧ as AoE Umbra Skill DMG per sec.

l.b: Increases the Umbra DMG Taken of targets within the magic circle.
l.s: Increases the Umbra DMG Taken of targets within the magic circle by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Mistique summons a ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩, increases her Minion DMG.
l.s: When Mistique summons a ⟨Lanterna Phantom⟩, increases her Minion DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, up to 10 stacks.

l.b: The Ultimate can inflict ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩ and its DMG is increased.
l.s: Midnight ★ Terror (Ultimate) can inflict ⟨Umbra Mark: Gloom⟩ and its DMG is increased by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When casting the Support Skill, the main Trekker gains a shield.
l.s: When casting Summoning Circle (Support Skill), the main Trekker gains a shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of Mistique's Base Max HP for 10s.

l.b: Increases Umbra Trekkers' DEF.
l.s: Increases Umbra Trekkers' DEF by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Mistique casts the Ultimate, sacrifices all of her minions to increase Ultimate DMG.
l.s: When Mistique casts Midnight ★ Terror, sacrifices all of her minions, each increasing Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, up to 6 stacks.

l.b: Energy Charge Efficiency increases when Mistique casts the Main Skill or Support Skill.
l.s: Energy Charge Efficiency +⟦0⟧ for 10s when Mistique casts the Main Skill or Support Skill.

l.b: When Mistique deals damage with the Ultimate, increases her Ultimate DMG.
